objective: Bind TOOL_DISCOVERY_SELECTION_AND_LEARNING to an identity-generic complete discovery-source interface over arbitrary finite frozen tool ecosystems, without enumerating tool identities, replaying terminal cases, or weakening the target.

target_semantics.protocol_scope: On arbitrary finite frozen tool ecosystems with hidden capability variants under the same frozen task population, harness, and tool authority.
target_semantics.unknown_identity: Tool identities not initially visible to the candidate are arbitrary opaque strings and may become visible only through declared discovery-source results.
target_semantics.changing_capability: Capability changes are represented by public version/epoch events; stale probe evidence is inadmissible after an epoch change.
target_semantics.route_goal: After complete discovery, choose the least-cost admissible route with current positive evidence for every required capability, or fail closed after all admissible routes are ruled out.
target_semantics.transfer_goal: Current-epoch probe evidence is reusable on later tasks without rediscovery or redundant reprobe.
target_semantics.unsupported_promotion: No hidden capability claim may be promoted without a current-epoch SAFE_CAPABILITY_PROBE receipt.

complete_discovery_source_interface.initial_visibility: Any finite subset V0 of E may be initially visible.
complete_discovery_source_interface.source_result: For each available declared source s, DISCOVER(s,q) returns finite public metadata for every tool identity in that source's frozen exposure set Ts relevant to the allowed query q; hidden capability truth is never returned.
complete_discovery_source_interface.completeness: V0 UNION THE UNION OF Ts OVER ALL AVAILABLE DECLARED SOURCES EQUALS THE COMPLETE TOOL-IDENTITY SET EXPOSED BY THE FROZEN TOOL AUTHORITY FOR BOTH BRAIN AND OPUS.
complete_discovery_source_interface.identity_rule: tool_id and source_id are opaque nonempty strings; no proof step depends on any enumerated identity.
complete_discovery_source_interface.duplicate_rule: Duplicate tool identities across sources must carry identical public metadata for the same epoch; conflicting metadata invalidates the interface instance fail-closed.
complete_discovery_source_interface.receipt_rule: A discovery receipt identifies exactly one declared source and is immutable within the frozen episode; one receipt makes that source queried.
complete_discovery_source_interface.authority_boundary: Tools not exposed by the common frozen tool authority are outside both routes' admissible information and are not silently counted as Brain misses.
complete_discovery_source_interface.finite_progress: Every valid DISCOVER adds one previously absent source receipt; every valid PROBE adds one previously absent current-epoch tool/capability receipt.

formal_lemmas.statement: Because the candidate contains no enumerated tool identity and uses tool_id only as an opaque map/tie-break key, renaming tool identities bijectively leaves every semantic decision invariant up to the same renaming.
For finite available source set S, each DISCOVER targets one unqueried source and the receipt makes it queried; therefore after at most |S| discovery steps every available source is exhausted.
By the complete-source interface contract, after source exhaustion the visible tool identities equal the entire tool set exposed by the common frozen authority, including identities absent initially.
For finite required-capability set R and finite visible tool set E, each PROBE resolves one previously unknown current-epoch (tool, capability) pair, so probe progress is finite.

After complete visibility, candidates are traversed in nondecreasing declared cost and opaque-id tie order; every earlier candidate is either inadmissible or has current negative evidence, so the first selected candidate is the least-cost evidence-supported sufficient route in the frozen authority.
SELECT is reachable only when no required capability is unknown or false for that tool; therefore every selected capability is backed by a current-epoch positive safe-probe receipt.
Probe receipts are reusable while their epoch equals the current public tool epoch and are ignored immediately after a version event changes that epoch, giving transfer without stale promotion.

After discovery exhaustion, the loop probes any not-yet-ruled-out admissible route before escalation; therefore escalation is reachable only when no evidence-supported sufficient route remains under the complete frozen authority.

For every valid finite interface instance, if an admissible sufficient tool exists the route eventually selects the least-cost such tool; otherwise it soundly escalates. Thus terminal-success/valid-route correctness reaches the pointwise contract ceiling without depending on an Opus comparator.

relation_to_existing_evidence.second_task_transfer: Already proved independently on the frozen 180-case terminal evidence and remains a separate predicate.
relation_to_existing_evidence.no_unsupported_promotion: Already proved independently on the frozen 180-case terminal evidence and remains a separate predicate.
relation_to_existing_evidence.prior_v3_grid: Regression/development evidence only; not used as universal proof.
relation_to_existing_evidence.current_formalism_cut: Correctly rejected the old pre-enumerated no-DISCOVER route. This relation does not revive that route; it replaces it with a DISCOVER-capable, discovery-first policy and an explicit complete-source semantics.
